boundary_notes: The faint, mirror-reversed writing across the whole page is show-through from the recto, fol. 70. It is visible in the adjacent context image: entries Gopālasahasranāmāvali through Gorakṣaśataka and the shelfmarks d. 670(4) through d. 458(4). It is not target-page text and is not transcribed as blocks.

uncertainties: The show-through is reversed and very faint. I cannot fully exclude a very faint original pencil mark, but on inspection of all native tiles every visible trace matches the mirrored recto layout.

page_annotations: I reviewed the overview and all six native tiles. The page has no original catalogue writing: no holdings, headings, cross-references or marginal or bottom notes.

The only original mark is the pencil folio number at the top left. It is written '70' with a superscript 'b', at approx. bbox [415,305,140,140], and is recorded as visible_folio. It is not catalogue text, so no record was created for it.

The faint, mirror-reversed writing across the ruled area is show-through from the recto, fol. 70 (source order 139). Its layout matches that page: shelfmark column at left, dates such as '1881: 20:7:D' at right, and the bottom note 'Text is on ff. 12-33' reversed near the foot. It was not transcribed as target-page text.

The page also shows non-writing physical features. A binding thread loop runs along the right/gutter edge (approx. [3200,660,60,900]). There are dark specks at the left edge (approx. [330,1050,60,200]) and a small diagonal smudge in the lower middle (approx. [2140,3870,120,60]). The stacked leaf edges at left and the printed ruling carry no writing.
unresolved_relationships: A very faint original pencil trace cannot be wholly excluded beneath the show-through. However, every visible trace inspected matches the mirrored layout of fol. 70.

coverage.finding: The pencil folio number at the top left is confirmed in native tile (0,0), at about x 425–550, y 330–440. It is recorded as visible_folio '70b' and in page_annotations. It is a page label, not a catalogue record. The written form is '70' followed by a raised 'b'.

The thread loop along the right (gutter) edge is confirmed in tile (1604,0), at about canvas x 3215–3240, y 660–1560. A second small thread fragment or tie also appears at the right edge lower down, at about [3215,3700,40,80] in tile (1604,3216). It is not mentioned by the candidate. It is a physical feature only, so no record is needed.

coverage.block_id: show_through (mirrored recto text over the whole ruled area)
coverage.finding: The faint reversed writing matches fol. 70. Examples are the mirrored date '1881: 20:7:D' at upper left, the mirrored shelfmark and date columns, and the mirrored 'Text is on ff. 12-33' near the foot at about canvas x 1680–2250, y 4690. It is correctly excluded as target text.

There are faint short horizontal strokes with a vertical stroke at about canvas x 1350–1440, y 4540–4640, and wavy marks just below them at about y 4740–4830. They are probably show-through, set-off or a stain. Their exact correspondence to a recto feature was not confirmed. No original wording is legible.

unresolved.issue: Faint dash-like strokes and wavy marks near the bottom centre-left could not be securely matched to the mirrored recto layout. They are most likely show-through, set-off from fol. 71, or a stain. A faint original pencil mark cannot be wholly excluded, but none of the traces forms legible text.
unresolved.next_check: Compare against a raking-light or reverse-lit image of the leaf, or overlay a mirrored fol. 70 image at native scale.

review.boundary_review: This is a verso with no original catalogue writing beyond the folio label '70b'. All faint writing is mirrored show-through from fol. 70. The stacked leaf edges at left belong to other leaves and carry no writing. Nothing from fol. 71 is transcribed. There are no cross-page or ditto relationships to establish.
